# Original controlled formative sample — 24 indicative marks
Suggested time: 55 minutes, including 5 minutes reading and 5 checking (approximately 1.9 working minutes per indicative mark). School may adapt; this is not an SCSA exam. It replaces the Week 12 lesson 3 slot. If used for the planned school theory assessment, teacher must adapt/approve coverage, marking, timing and authentication; do not add another summative task. Default closed-answer/notes for formative attempt, paper SQL permitted.
Fresh facts: same six-table design, S04 now has M02 and M05 bookings, no Attendance for those pairs; capacity remains 4. Other seed unchanged. The hypothetical app still trusts browser role strings. Federal entity/date assumptions match review case; eligibility has not been established.
R1 (4): explain Booking key and Attendance composite reference; state one permitted and one rejected pair operation, with reason (1 mark each).
R2 (6): write a report including ALL sessions, booking count and remaining places. Criteria: LEFT JOIN (1), correct link (1), COUNT(non-null child) (1), grouping (1), calculated field/aliases (1), correct S04 output of 2 bookings and 2 remaining places and deterministic sort (1).
R3 (4): an insert-booking then invalid Present = 2 fails. Explain explicit transaction/rollback, expected booking effect, domain constraint and why this doesn't prove crash durability (1 each).
R4 (4): learner-labelled allowed 250-row export then deny event. Give observed fact (1), alternative explanation/unknown (1), server-side control (1), legitimate/prohibited test pair (1). No blame or notification verdict from counts alone.
R5 (3): identify certificate public binding/server private proof (1), authenticated agreement secret derivation (1), symmetric authenticated records plus a remaining authorisation/endpoint limit (1). No RSA transport claim.
R6 (3): name relevant security principle APP 11 and context (1); give missing eligibility fact/need for prompt assessment (1); explain that 30 days isn't a notification waiting period and a WA public-sector counterfactual needs separate coverage/date analysis (1).
Use supplied marking checkpoints and record one fresh retry after feedback; default formative sample is not an extra school assessment.
